body.description: Elías, Juno's father, a tired man in his thirties: short dark hair, faded blue work shirt, dark trousers, calloused hands, kind tired face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
